The signs (-1), (-1)^i and (-1)^j act freely, allowing the a00=a01=a10=+1 8192-state quotient. Independently enumerating ALL 65,536 original bit patterns (not relying on quotient to count) found minimum 304, exactly 32 arrays, and next moment 336. On every one of the 8192 normalized arrays the two distinct formulas matched exactly. Explicit dihedral/modulation orbit enumeration produced disjoint orbit sizes 16+16 with dominant |C|=3 shift dot-product magnitudes 0 and 8; every winner had 16 zero, 6 unit and 2 magnitude-three half-plane correlations. Matrix representatives in RESULT.md give words 19336 and 22976 and are in different orbits. Finite exhaustion is complete only for the specified finite binary square; standard formulas are proved by Parseval. Source checker.py and all record text were read, but our exhaustive verifier was independently written.
